notes.title: MEGA UPDATE (I'm working on it)
notes.notes:
HELLO EVERYONE!!!

Tired of classic modes and classic updates?

This boring thing will be over in a few days!

I'm working on a new game mode, or rather, a lot of game modes.
I tell you the goal: it will not be one map, but there will be many and the goal will be nothing.. this "mode" will be the beginning, how the house has become completely protected, or what are you doing there etc. This mode will be a story of all the others... In short it will be the story mode! 
[b]Thank you all![/b]
[i]More information soon.[/i]

[i][u]if you want you can join our discord for more information and spoilers![/u][/i]
https://discord.gg/HuNctWm

I'm finally here after a very long time to tell you that the game continues! Will still receive updates and updates!!
